Validate paper.yaml, targets.yaml and consistency.yaml against the rubric. Without --final, undecided outcomes and reviews are warnings; with --final everything must be decided, audit.json current, the report drawn from it and safe (only storyteller's scripts, nothing loaded from outside the file), and the pipeline packed: what seal requires.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower audit check [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir string` | `audit` | the audit folder (paper.yaml, targets.yaml, consistency.yaml) |
| `--final` |  | everything must be decided, scored, in the report and packed |
